title: billing_alerts gets its reader: org-scoped money alerts with a resolve door
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: case 7 is a declared GUARD case against a committed golden (app/_lib/billing/__fixtures__/charge-parity.json, generated on the base tree via KP_WRITE_CHARGE_PARITY=1) snapshotting billing_state/events/credits/usage (wall-clock stamps and random org ids normalized) + billingOverview pre-existing keys + meterAllowance per meter x org + a meterGate interview_minutes 402 probe (org B), asserted byte-identical before and after every alert is read via GET and resolved; its golden half was green before by design, its resolve half red. Wire parity (case 6) also compares against the golden (freshGet), not 'the response captured before'. Migration case lives in a new app/_lib/db/billing-alerts-migration.test.ts (in-process legacy table at the isolated KP_DB_PATH) instead of editing core-migrations.test.ts. The resolve route inlines requireOrgCapability('org:manage') with the same 401/403-BILLING_ORG_MANAGE_REQUIRED shape as requireBillingAuthority, because app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts is a source ratchet that cannot see the delegated gate (joining its allowlist would have grown a ratchet). Added getBillingAlert(id, orgId) to the store (org-bound, pinned in billing-tenancy.test.ts) for the 404/409 split. BillingPayload.alerts is optional so older fixtures type-check. Shared surfaces: 4 error codes appended (1 STORE, 3 REFUSAL) with 4-locale catalog keys + billing.alerts panel copy; api-reference regenerated (1 gated row); perf-budget raised by this card's measured share only.
notes: CHARGE CHECK: nothing touched changes what a tenant is charged, when or how much - the reader writes only billing_alerts (resolved_at + the new nullable resolution column); entitledPlan/meterOverview/meterAllowance/recordMeterUsage/meterGate untouched, proven by the golden guard. core.ts: one line appended at the END of the ALTER migration list (no reflow). tsc: the only errors are under the untracked kpi-sim/ directory (foreign, pre-existing). test:perf red on the combined working tree from siblings only: measured with a clean worktree, base 1171b99ca + this card's commits alone crossed only app/page.tsx modules (+1, BillingAlertsPanel) - raised in 054e090cd - and HEAD without this card's commits was already over on 10 route graphs (hire-from-need, analyze, redraft, devcase approve/submit, intake promote, jds generate, interview-kit, status letter, tasks retry) from sibling commits; this card's own +3..4 KB per route graph (db/billing.ts +2230 B, core.ts +328 B, api-response.ts ~850 B) was raised per route and on the app/api/**/route.ts pattern (+3). Remaining overage lines are sibling growth (page.tsx 8874 KB is a sibling's UNCOMMITTED files). Full test:unit: first run had 2 BROKEN - route-capability-coverage (mine, fixed in 627d64ec2) and python-runner-concurrency (load-dependent under the shared box; passes alone, untouched files); second full run 10157/10157 green. Known edge (documented): recordBillingAlert dedupes on OPEN rows only, so an alert resolved as 'fixed' whose cause persists re-opens on the next webhook/reconcile for the same ref - alert list only, no money effect. The unmapped_product customer copy says the plan has not changed and not to pay again; it does not claim the operator was notified (other orgs' unmapped alerts are not surfaced to the operator on this tab - that is the deployment-wide listBillingAlerts, still without a UI reader).
